planExpired.title: Your {plan} plan has expired
planExpired.body: The plan expired on {at}: AI and plan limits are paused. Inbox, data and top-up credits are kept.
planExpired.retain: Data is kept until {at}. Renew before then to keep full access.
planExpired.askOwner: Ask the Owner to renew the plan.

billingNotice.lowBody: Your plan credits are running low. Top up so AI is not interrupted — there is no auto top-up.
billingNotice.exhaustedBody: AI is paused: conversations the AI was answering have been handed to people. Inbox, data and manual replies keep working.
billingNotice.restoredBody: AI can be used again. Conversations handed to people stay with them — turn AI back on per conversation when needed.
billingNotice.askOwner: Ask the workspace owner to top up credits.
